sourceProfile.shape_origin: declared example; statically inferred, not observed
sourceProfile.drawing_scope: Notebook caller sigmoid and cumprod subgraph only; not a custom nn.Module, not the MLP or external loss.

sourceFacts: MLP.fc is an ordinary K-1-output Linear. Its logits enter this separate caller decoding block.
The j-th tail probability is the product of conditional probabilities through threshold j; sigmoid alone is insufficient.
Evidence uses Notebook module scope and preserved cell mappings, rather than inventing a CORNDecoder class.
sourceSemantics: recorded graph projection; imported SVG glyphs; source model not executed
